# `Q-5-62` — Book Download Not Rendered

> `book.downloads` lists a format, so the book's sidebar links to its
> file, but that file is not in the output directory.

## What this means

`downloads: [epub]` (or `pdf`, `docx`) adds a download link to the
book's sidebar. The link points at a file in the book's output
directory, such as `_book/My-Book.epub`.

Quarto 2 renders one format per run. A plain `q2 render` of an HTML book
writes the HTML pages and the link, but not the file the link points
at. Until that file exists, a reader who clicks the link gets "not
found". Quarto 1 writes every format in `format:` in one run, so a book
moved from Quarto 1 does not expect this second step.

The warning goes away once the file is in the output directory.

## How to fix it

Render the download's format as well. The warning names the command:

```bash
q2 render --to epub
```

For a `pdf` download the format is `typst`:

```bash
q2 render --to typst
```

Then publish the output directory as usual. To stop offering the
download instead, remove the format from `book.downloads`.
